stem: A Voltmarkt store has 1.5 weeks of cover on a laptop. The next regular delivery arrives in 3 weeks. A transfer from another store, enough for 2 more weeks of sales, arrives in 1 week. Assuming sales continue at the same pace, which statement is right?

options.text: The store runs out after 1.5 weeks, because cover counts only the stock on hand
The store runs out after 3 weeks, just as the regular delivery arrives
The store should not run out: with the transfer, stock lasts about 3.5 weeks
The cover cannot be judged until the transfer has arrived in the store
